\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{datavisualization}
\begin{document}
\tikz \datavisualization[
  scientific axes=clean,
  x axis={ticks={
    low=-2pt,
    common={low=-3pt},
    major={low=-4pt,
      at={2 as [{style=red,low=-5pt}] $a$,0,1},
      also at={2 as [{style=blue,low=-7pt}] $b$},
      options at={2 as [{low=-8pt}] ignored}
    }
  }},
  y axis={ticks={step=1}},
  visualize as line
] data point[x=0,y=0] data point[x=2,y=1];
\end{document}
